scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @picup/web dev" "pnpm --filter @picup/api dev" "pnpm --filter @picup/api dev:worker"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @picup/shared build && pnpm --filter @picup/api build && pnpm --filter @picup/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @picup/shared build && pnpm --filter @picup/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @picup/web typecheck
